# Mesher vendor bundle

`cdt2d.js` bundles cdt2d by Mikola Lysenko and its dependencies.
[cdt2d-LICENSES.txt](cdt2d-LICENSES.txt) preserves each component's full MIT
license and copyright notice. [cdt2d-PROVENANCE.json](cdt2d-PROVENANCE.json)
records package versions, repositories and original source hashes.

These upstream MIT licenses are retained alongside alula's GPL license.
